templates.why_chosen: '(a) Now: Library+Sidecar' vs '(b) Our Vision' with an inside legend and per-panel operation traces that can be counted.
templates.what_to_learn: Naming the panels by claim rather than by system, and adding a countable trace strip under each, turns a structural comparison into a quantitative one.

templates.why_chosen: Explicitly cross-referenced in the reference guide as a two-panel-filed baseline-vs-ours exemplar: identical Client/App/Kernel/NIC skeleton in both halves, with an in-figure legend and the M/U circles along each trace counting 12 steps versus 4.
templates.what_to_learn: Keep the client/app/kernel/NIC stack identical and in the same position in both panels, then let small repeated icons (the M/U marshal circles) along a bottom trace let the reader literally count the efficiency win; note the weakness that placing the legend far above the trace it explains hurts lookup.
